title: US Hang Gliding & Paragliding

services.name: disallowed recreational tandems
services.desc: By letter dated July 18, 2022, you petitioned the FAA on behalf U.S. Hang Gliding and Paragliding Association, Inc., (USHPA) for an extension to Exemption No. 4721R. That exemption from § 103.1(a) and (b) of Title 14, Code of Federal Regulations (14 CFR) allows USHPA to operate unpowered ultralight vehicles (hang gliders and paragliders) weighing less than 155 pounds, with another occupant, for the purpose of training. 1. Recreational Flights The FAA has outlined the following limitation: “All flights operating under this exemption must be for training purposes only.” This condition disallows purely recreational tandem flights between Tandem 1-rated pilots (T1) and H2/P2 pilots and above.
